subject: GCP private offer: proposed list-price offset and reseller split
messages:
From: CloudResell Inc <partners@cloudresell.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Introduction + GCP private offer economics

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick intro. We're in active discussions with BigCorp's platform team on a proof-of-concept and they want us to submit a GCP private offer this week. Before we draft the PO we need clarity on two things that procurement will ask about:

1) The acceptable list-price offset (we need a published max discount off public list that still qualifies for private-offer publishing)
2) The reseller margin split (what share CloudResell can retain on top of the list price)

If you can share a target band (e.g., list price offset range + suggested margin bands by ARR tier) that would let us build the offer templates. We attached a draft intention/partner brief (CR_Intent_to_Resell_v2.docx).

Also: is Redwood comfortable with a two-tier waterfall where CloudResell gets a higher share if they hit usage thresholds? BigCorp procurement likes performance-based splits.

Appreciate a quick POV, we have a Friday deadline from their procurement team.

— Priya / CloudResell Partnerships

Attachments: CR_Intent_to_Resell_v2.docx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: CloudResell Inc <partners@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Introduction + GCP private offer economics

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the brief and the doc. Quick answers up-front:

- List-price offset: our typical maximum published offset for private offers is 35% off public list for strategic channel deals; for volume-driven PO (>$250k ARR) we can consider up to 45% but only with a revenue commit and quarterly minimums.
- Reseller margin: we normally structure a three-band waterfall: 18% baseline, 25% at a 1.5x usage threshold, 32% at 2.5x. The bands are negotiable per-account when there's an ARR commit or joint marketing investment.

I'll loop Finance for floor checks and Legal for minimum term language. See attached quick sketch (proposed_split_v1.xlsx) — not final, just a starting point.

Vanessa / Karthik — flagged for FYI: BigCorp PO timing looks tight; can finance confirm whether the 18% baseline is allowable on GCP marketplace private offers and whether a 45% list offset is supportable with an ARR commit?

Evelyn

Attachments: proposed_split_v1.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Introduction + GCP private offer economics

On Mon, Nov 8, 2026 at 11:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - List-price offset: our typical maximum published offset for private offers is 35% ...
> - Reseller margin: three-band waterfall: 18% baseline, 25% at 1.5x, 32% at 2.5x.

Couple of notes from Rev/Finance:

1) Revenue recognition: if we allow >30% list offset without a binding ARR commitment, we increase bad-debt/reserve risk on channel accounts. For GCP marketplace PO flow we need a signed MOU that enumerates minimums to put above-30% offsets into effect.

2) Cost-of-goods: some of these POs will include usage credits and marketing co-funding; treat those as contra-revenue in waterfall calculations. Baseline 18% is fine for standard reseller deals but any plan that increases to 32% must have a clear clawback/true-up each quarter.

3) Contract/legal asks: include a price-protection clause (90 days), and a cap on downstream discounts CloudResell can offer (they must not list below the negotiated private-offer list). I'll draft language.

I attached a short note we use internally (legal_comment.txt) — will convert it to a redline if we proceed.

Marcus

Attachments: legal_comment.txt
From: CloudResell Inc <partners@cloudresell.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: BigCorp Procurement <procurement@bigcorp.com>, GCP Marketplace Sales <gcp-marketplace-sales@google.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Introduction + GCP private offer economics

Thanks Marcus / Evelyn — helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:

- BigCorp is comfortable signing a 12-month MOU if we can get the 40% offset band for the first 6 months and the tiered margin structure you proposed. They need to see the clawback terms though.
- Procurement will require the private-offer list price to be the published list less the offset (they dislike ad-hoc per-invoice discounts).
- We will need a DocuSign-ready term sheet to present internally. Can Redwood provide a single-sheet private-offer term sheet (no redlines) we can attach to our internal SOW?

If you can get back to us with a DocuSign link or final term sheet by Wednesday (US PST) we can route to BigCorp procurement the same day.

— Priya
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: CloudResell Inc <partners@cloudresell.com>, BigCorp Procurement <procurement@bigcorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T23:45:00Z
Subject: Final: GCP private offer term sheet and next steps

Priya / BigCorp team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Per internal finance/legal review we can agree to the following, subject to signature of the MOU and the private-offer term sheet:

- Published list-price offset: 40% for the initial 6-month promotional period, reverting to 30% thereafter unless quarterly usage minimums are met.
- Reseller waterfall: 18% baseline; 25% at 1.5x usage; 32% at 2.5x. Quarterly true-ups with a 60-day clawback window.
- Minimum commit: $275,000 ARR over 12 months to enable >35% offsets.
- Term/protection: 12-month MOU, 90-day price protection on the private-offer list, no downstream listing below negotiated list.

I attached the single-page private-offer term sheet (private_offer_term_sheet_v3.pdf) and a lightweight MOU template. Once you approve the term sheet we will publish the private offer on GCP and share the DocuSign room link.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today (EOD PST): CloudResell confirms acceptance of the term sheet and returns executed MOU (or sends redlines).
- Within 24 hours of signed MOU: Redwood publishes private offer on GCP and provides DocuSign link for BigCorp signature.
- Week 1 after activation: Joint onboarding call + usage thresholds baseline review.

If that's all good, Priya please confirm and we'll circulate the DocuSign room.

Thanks — Evelyn

Attachments: private_offer_term_sheet_v3.pdf, CR_MOU_template_v1.docx
